<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a craft-able crafting material, obtainable by refining wood at [[Carpenter's workbench II]]. Its only use is to craft [[Soul container III (Base)]].

As of v1.404, it is implemented, and 4 silver quality pieces are used for the construction of the  [[Soul container III (Base)]].
